messages:
maya (People Ops): following up from today's all-hands: quick Q&A about the team resync and hiring runway. please keep it short.
kevin (CEO): headline: prioritize infra, runtime, and enterprise reliability for the next two quarters.
tara (Head of Eng): we're consolidating teams for clearer ownership (16 -> 12). no layoffs; mostly role realignments.
sam (SWE): will product sprint commitments change?
tara (Head of Eng): minimal disruption. handoffs scheduled across 2 sprints; maintain current OKRs.
ravi (VP Infra): infra and SRE hires are expedited to meet SLA targets. critical reqs get "expedite" approval.
jean (Recruiter): logistics: expedite reqs -> posting in 48 hours; standard reqs -> ~7 business days. include two impact metrics. link: https://redwood/internal/hiring-guidelines
maya (People Ops): headcount preview: Q1 +11 (infra 5, runtime 3, reliability 3); Q2 +13 (platform 6, enterprise 4, research 3); backfills ~6.
sam (SWE): can teams use contractors during transitions?
tara (Head of Eng): yes, short-term contractors (<=12 weeks) allowed for experiments. long-term owners need FT hires.
mobility-bot: Reminder: internal mobility window opens 10 days after mapping is published. post stretch roles in #internal-moves.
maya (People Ops): we'll publish the mapping and an FAQ tomorrow. DM me or @jean for private questions. :v:
